miniz 11.3.2 (https://github.com/richgel999/miniz, commit 2948eebafc5b9f1c69bebed80333e403a09bd62d), MIT licence, see LICENSE-miniz.
The .c and .h files are unmodified copies; only miniz_export.h is ours (the upstream one is generated by CMake).
Build flags used by this project: -DMINIZ_NO_STDIO (the ROM zip is read into memory by the program itself) -DMINIZ_NO_TIME -DMINIZ_NO_ARCHIVE_WRITING_APIS (the game cannot write zips). The test uses a variant with writing enabled to build in-memory test archives.
